brief:
Build a professional Dutch invoice app on my EXISTING Studio table "Facturen" (key facturen; read only — an automation fills it from PDF invoices). Call app_set_plan first, then app_link_datatable {datatableId:"tbl_x"} and use the tbl_ id it returns. Never app_upsert_table or app_seed_records.
Screen "Overzicht": stat tiles — aantal facturen (count), totaal excl. btw (sum excl_btw), totaal btw (sum btw), totaal incl. btw (sum totaal); a chart of totaal per month over datum; a filter_bar on leverancier, datum, status; a data_grid with datum, leverancier, factuurnummer, excl_btw, btw, totaal, status.
Screen "Factuur": record_detail of one row (all fields), opened from the grid row.
Dutch labels everywhere (Datum, Leverancier, Factuurnummer, Excl. btw, Btw, Totaal, Status). App name "Facturen". Finish with app_finalize.
